visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a light beige t-shirt and brown shorts is positioned on all fours on a colorful geometric play mat. A baby wearing a light green patterned onesie sits next to her head, playfully grabbing her dark hair. The background is filled with various children's toys and a large white storage basket. (2) The woman stands in a bright living room, facing the camera directly. Her hair is tied in a ponytail, and she gestures with five fingers spread wide to emphasize a point. Behind her is a white fireplace mantel, a bookshelf, and a large brown massage chair. (3) The woman holds the baby securely at chest height and performs deep squats before lifting the baby straight up into the air above her head. The room contains a tall silver pole and mirrors that reflect the surrounding home environment. (4) Lying on her back on the mat, the woman positions the baby on her lower torso and performs bridge exercises by lifting her hips repeatedly. The baby appears engaged and smiles throughout the movement. The indoor lighting is natural and bright. (5) A man wearing a graphic t-shirt and patterned grey shorts holds the baby under the arms. He performs bicep curls, lifting the baby up and down like a weight. A black television screen and a wooden baby gate are visible. (6) The woman stands and holds the baby against her chest while rotating her torso from side to side. She maintains a smiling, energetic facial expression. The scene is reflected in large wall mirrors showing a dining area. (7) The woman performs a series of forward lunges across the room while holding the baby. A white robot vacuum cleaner is visible on the floor in the background near a wooden dining table and chairs. (8) The woman lies flat on her back on the play mat, looking exhausted but happy, with the baby resting on her chest. She wears glasses in this final shot, and scattered toys surround them on the mat.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家有了小孩之後. [Variety]: 是不是沒有時間運動啊!!. (2) [Subtitle]: 我們今天教你5招 大人小孩都會很愛的運動!!. (3) [Subtitle]: 第一個深蹲舉高高!!. (4) [Subtitle]: 真的超級爆累 但是小孩超愛 每次他都會笑咪咪 除了深蹲的時候 可以鍛鍊到臀部 舉高高的時候 還可以鍛鍊到背部 絕對是一個做個5下 就會累死你的活動. (5) [Subtitle]: 第二個負重橋式 把小孩放在你的胯部 然後做橋式運動 很多產後婦女 都會有各種骨盆腔的問題 這個時候 其實要多做橋式 鍛鍊臀部 所以這個動作 可以說是一舉兩得 小孩也很愛 也可以改善你的臀部疼痛. (6) [Subtitle]: 第三個二頭肌硬舉 就通常要爸爸比較有辦法 坦白說 我是有點抬不太動了. (7) [Subtitle]: 第四招轉體向上 小孩子可以享受飛高高的快感 你可以鍛鍊你的側腹肌 畢竟平時在電腦桌前面 都是全身僵硬啊 多練一點扭轉的動作 對脊椎比較好哦!!. (8) [Subtitle]: 最後一個負重深蹲 特別是單腿的深蹲 對鍛鍊骨盆跟大腿的效果 都特別好 隨著小孩越來越重 你會覺得訓練強度越來越強 非常方便喔. (9) [Variety]: 我要死了.
